human_annotation_coverage.basis: deduplicated by (model, question id): 90 spot-checked rows + 75 adjudicated rows - 16 in both = 149 of 450 rows with an independent human correctness record; of the 375 presumed rows, 74 were also spot-checked with a label equal to the two-judge label and 301 were never human reviewed. human_adjudicated: false means "not part of the disagreement-adjudication workflow", NOT "never reviewed by a human"

final_correctness_distribution.basis: 375 rows are the presumed value where the two AI judges already agreed; only the 75 disagreement rows were adjudicated item by item by the project owner

cause_adjudication.scope: the 18 rows that the 90-row human spot check marked 不一致 with error type 该答却拒答
cause_adjudication.derivation: 16 rows in qa/成因待确认.csv are all 库内存在但未进上下文; 4 further rows were filled directly by the reviewer as 检索没给到 in the spot-check tables; 14 + 4 = 18 refused-answer rows. The 16-row table also contains 2 rows outside that scope (回答不完整 / 数值错误), which are published separately instead of being dropped.
cause_adjudication.note: The adjudicated object is the chunk registered when the question was written, not proof that the fragment the model received contained no equivalent evidence; splitting "retrieval did not supply it" from "the model did not read it" still needs a controlled experiment (not done)

release_scope: metadata and labels; evidence text and raw responses omitted
